differential.name: Essential hypertension
differential.rationale: Long‑standing hypertension contributes to CKD progression and is listed as an active condition.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Anemia present in the context of CKD and chronic inflammation (e.g., sinusitis) without overt iron deficiency.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome
differential.rationale: Obesity (BMI 30.3), prediabetes, dyslipidemia, and hypertension fulfill criteria.

differential.name: Chronic sinusitis
differential.rationale: Documented chronic sinusitis can cause systemic inflammation and contribute to anemia and overall morbidity.
